title: Finite relation maps have finite support over quasi-compact basis opens
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a basis whose members are quasi-compact. Let $A,B$ be sets, let $U_a,V_b\in\mathcal B$, and let $S_a,T_b$ be finite sets. For either morphism $h:\coprod_{b\in B}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a\in A}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], where $j_!$ is [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty], and every finite subset $B'\subset B$, there is a finite subset $A'\subset A$ such that the restriction of $h$ to $\coprod_{b\in B'}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}$ factors through $\coprod_{a\in A'}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma Tag 0CAI (lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles), proof at lines 3047-3058: finite subsets of B have finite supports in A because sections over quasi-compact V_b commute with the directed coproduct
